$description: Margin design tokens v1 (2026-09-24). Source of truth for margin/design/theme/*.json (generated by theme/_build/generate-themes.mjs) and for CSS work in the workbench. Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group draft ($value/$type). Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x against the named surface, measured on opaque composited values.

meta.name: Margin
meta.authority: DESIGN-GUIDE.md section 2 explains every token role. If a value here disagrees with docs/04-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md, this file wins; 04 is the product-level summary.

canvas.$description: The page. Editor, document footer, title bar over the document, quick input, menus.

shell.$description: The tray the page sits in. Shelf (side bar), title-bar segment above the shelf, status-bar segment below it.

sunken.$description: Inset content on canvas: code blocks, inline code, segmented-control track, keybinding keycaps.

raised.$description: Overlays (palette, menus, hovers, dialogs, toasts). Same white as canvas; elevation is carried by edge + shadow, never by tint.

hoverOnCanvas.$description: Hover fill for controls sitting on canvas.

hoverOnShell.$description: Hover fill for rows sitting on shell.

scrim.$description: Behind modal dialogs only. 12% ink-blue. Never behind the palette.

hairline.$description: Structural separator (shelf edge, panel top). Decorative: not a control boundary.

subtle.$description: Row dividers inside a surface (settings rows, palette divider).

control.$description: Boundary that identifies an interactive control (checkbox, radio, input when focused-less). 3.07:1 on canvas (WCAG 1.4.11).

controlQuiet.$description: Selected segment edge, find-field edge at rest where the fill already defines the control.

primary.$description: Body text, headings, titles. 15.36:1 on canvas.

secondary.$description: Labels, metadata, footer, section labels, icons. 6.15:1 canvas, 5.74:1 shell.

tertiary.$description: Placeholders, comments, URLs, active line number. 5.07:1 canvas, 4.73:1 shell.

quiet.$description: Inactive line numbers, whitespace glyphs, ruler. 3.07:1: incidental text only; HC replaces it.

disabled.$description: Disabled labels. Exempt from contrast by WCAG; always paired with a non-color cue.

base.$description: Margin blue. Caret, focus ring, links, checked checkbox, primary button, active indicators. 5.30:1 on canvas.

hover.$description: Hovered primary button; accent text on tints (6.67:1 canvas, 5.61:1 on tint).

tint.$description: Selected row in shelf, settings nav, palette.

tintSubtle.$description: Hover on a selected row; drop target.

selection.$description: Text selection, focused editor. Ink stays primary (11.27:1).

selectionInactive.$description: Text selection when the editor is not focused.

rule.$description: Blockquote rule; the margin line echoed inside documents.

successInk.$description: Used only for diff insertions and Git added. Never for 'Saved'.

findMatch.$description: Current find match. Warm, because blue already means selection. Ink on it 11.03:1.

raw.$description: 5.05:1; Markdown inline code and fences in Code view

dark.$description: Night paper. Graphite, not black; the page still reads as a sheet (canvas darker than shell is WRONG: shell is lighter so the page recedes like paper under a lamp).

base.$description: Caret, links, focus ring, checked box. 6.95:1 canvas.

highContrast.$description: Two strategies. (1) Windows Contrast Themes active: VS Code switches to hc-black / hc-light automatically (window.autoDetectHighContrast, default true) and Margin ships margin-hc-light-color-theme.json + relies on upstream hc_black semantics; system colors win. (2) CSS in rich Markdown webview uses @media (forced-colors: active) with CSS system colors. Values below are for the HC Light theme.

border.$description: contrastBorder: every surface edge is drawn

ui.$description: System; not bundled. Windows 11 ships the Variable family; Windows 10 falls back to Segoe UI.

display.$description: Optical size for 24px+ (document H1/H2, settings page title).

documentSerif.$description: Bundled (OFL). Optional document face; Print default when chosen.

mono.$description: Bundled Cascadia Code (OFL) so Windows 10 gets it; Code view, terminal, inline code, fences.

semibold.$description: Only two weights in UI and documents. Bold Markdown (**x**) renders 600 in Sans, 650 in Source Serif (optical match).

ui.$description: Workbench roles. Maps 1:1 onto the upstream ramp (--vscode-fontSize-*) with two Margin additions: title (13/18 semibold) and pageTitle (24/32).

pageTitle.use: Settings page heading, welcome/recovery surface title

title.use: Document title in title bar, setting label, result title

body.use: Shelf rows, menus, palette rows, buttons

caption.use: Keycaps, badges only. Never body copy.

document.$description: Write and Read share these exactly so switching modes never reflows (px at 100% text size; all scale with the Document Text Size setting, base 17).

lead.use: First paragraph after H1 only when the author wrote it that way; never auto-styled

measure.$description: Max text column width (px at 100%). 680 at 17px Segoe UI Variable Text = 68-72 characters per line.

space.$description: Upstream spacing ramp (--vscode-spacing-size*). Margin adds 48/56/64 for document insets only.

radius.$description: Elevation tiers from the upstream design philosophy. Margin adds 'window' (OS) and caps overlays at 12.

control.use: buttons, inputs, list rows, segments, checkbox (4 at 18px)

inner.use: segment track, code block, notice, image

outer.use: menus, hovers, toasts, suggest widget, find widget

window.use: Provided by Windows 11 DWM; never drawn by CSS

circle.use: toggle switch track and knob, radio

elevation.$description: Shadow only on things that overlap other things. Values are CSS box-shadow; widget.shadow theme key carries the single-color fallback.

0.use: Every docked part: shelf, editor, panel, bars

1.use: Selected segment in segmented control; toggle knob

2.use: Menus, hovers, suggest, find widget, toasts

motion.$description: Motion confirms, orients, or smooths a jump. Nothing gates input. prefers-reduced-motion and workbench.reduceMotion remove spatial movement; opacity/color stay (at 0-80ms).

instant.use: pointer-down fill, caret placement, mode switch

base.use: overlay fade-in, segment thumb slide, toast in

standard.use: most transitions (Fluent 'fast out, slow in' ~ Apple ease-out)

exit.use: things leaving; exits run at 70% of enter duration

spring.use: shelf width and segment thumb: critically damped, no overshoot

rules.shelf: width, gentle, spring; content does not fade; document column stays centered and slides with the available width
rules.segment: selected thumb slides between segments, base, spring; labels never animate
rules.never: bounce, scale-up on open, skeleton shimmer, animated gradients, caret glide on mode switch, text reflow animation

focus.rule: Keyboard focus only (:focus-visible). Inside lists, the focused row gets list.focusOutline (1px accent, inset) rather than an outside ring so rows do not overlap.
